items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Lumsie was a fellow. He was one of the pimps.

ctx.x: She could steal a nickel off a dead man's eye. She was somebody. Tack Annie, Alabama Mary, Lumsie. Lumsie was a fellow. He was one of the pimps. And Lumsie used to pawn everything, you know, everything he'd get his hands on he'd go and pawn it, you know. So Lumsie got down to the last thing and he had a photograph of the Lord. So Lumsie took that to the pawnshop, and they told Lumsie, said, 'Listen Lumsie, you've brought everything in here, but we are not going to let you pawn Jesus Christ.'
